name: stagger-list
title: Stagger List
description: A list whose items arrive one after another the first time it scrolls into view: steps of a process, recent updates, the points of an argument. The arrival gives the eye an order to read in; the list itself is ordinary.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/stagger-list

Installed to `components/ui/effects/stagger-list.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/stagger-list';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/stagger-list

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
